crossRefs.note: These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son…
So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of…
So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were given cymbals of bronze to sound aloud;
and with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to Yahweh…
and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for…
Yahweh, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.
